subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should this issue be scoped to documenting the shipped pi-tui multiline shortcuts, or should OpenClaw add a supported TUI send/newline keybinding configuration or CLI surface?
rationale: The core Shift+Enter newline behavior already ships through pi-tui, but exposing configurable Enter/Ctrl/Cmd/Shift Enter behavior would add a new user-facing config or CLI contract under OpenClaw's high config-surface bar.

options.title: Document Shipped Shortcuts First
options.body: Update docs and /help for Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and the backslash fallback while deferring configurable keybindings to an explicit maintainer-approved design.

options.title: Add TUI Keybinding Config
options.body: Introduce a narrow config or CLI bridge into pi-tui keybindings with schema/help/docs/tests and upgrade proof for existing users.

options.title: Close As Basic Behavior Shipped
options.body: Treat the shipped dependency behavior as sufficient and leave configurable keybindings to separate future proposals.

recommendation.title: Document Shipped Shortcuts First
recommendation.body: Update docs and /help for Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and the backslash fallback while deferring configurable keybindings to an explicit maintainer-approved design.

likelyOwner.reason: The current TUI docs/help/config and wrapper history in this checkout point to steipete as the best available routing owner for the product-surface decision.
